summary: Maintains Project desired conditions, facts/impacts/dynamic-gap Case v4 state, Iteration aggregation, and deterministic human/Runtime transition commits under the current protocol only.
runtime_notes: Runtime must resolve and call the trusted entrypoints declared by this capability instead of maintaining copied ledger scripts.
Agent-directed Case creation enters through case_control with semantic initial facts, relevant impacts, and at least one gap; ledger allocates ids and atomically registers the v4 Case.
Case transitions use Case revision binding and exact candidate-gap matching; resolved transitions also bind the observed Project revision.
Different Cases may execute concurrently; Case, Project, iteration, projections, and indexes commit under one cross-process Project lock with rollback.
Iteration v2 contains only macro targets, accepted Project changes bound to closed Cases, acceptance state, and Case refs; Loop continuation is forbidden.
Project and Iteration audits reject uncovered actionable dimensions, volatile evidence refs, and active Case reference drift.
Runtime passes the semantic Case transition object directly; stdin and caller-owned files are CLI transports and volatile paths never become evidence.
Runtime-owned result, activity, event, and transcript records stay outside the target project; Desktop may pass an arckit-runtime://runs/RUN-... opaque reference for Case round traceability.
Case rendering is content-transparent and dry-run preflights Structured Record round trips plus existing Case index inputs.
Runtime exposes bounded ledger snapshots to the Agent when needed; only trusted Runtime entrypoints may write ledger state.
